# Interesting Ideas & Technologies

A collection of tools, libraries, frameworks, and concepts that could potentially be incorporated into RepoSense or explored for future enhancements.

---

## Driver.js

**Description**

Driver.js is an open-source JavaScript library used to create interactive, step-by-step guided tours and feature introductions for web applications.

**Potential Use Cases**

- First-time user onboarding
- Guided walkthrough of RepoSense features
- Interactive tutorials
- Highlighting newly added features
- Context-aware help for users

**Resources**

- Official Website: https://driverjs.com/
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/kamranahmedse/driver.js

**Status**

- [ ] Research
- [ ] Prototype
- [ ] Integrate
